requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Reduce the number of product references (names) for HP OfficeJet Pro 9010 series on 123.hp.com to a maximum of one, to avoid user confusion and errors.

requirements.Requirement: Printer able to run all new/current EM / market segment media
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Printer must reliably print on all new and current EM (Evaluation Media) and market segment media, meeting regional intervention specifications and climatic conditions for the Manhattan platform.

requirements.Requirement: Product can be placed and work on uneven surface ( sofa , table cloth , carpet …)
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Printer must operate without functional or hardware issues when placed and used on uneven surfaces such as sofas, table cloths, or carpets.

requirements.Requirement: Tilt left and right each while printing
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Printer must function without failure if tilted left or right up to 20 degrees while printing.

requirements.Requirement: Put printer on trolley and print
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Printer must print without print quality issues when placed on a moving trolley.
